topic: Korea's free national flu shot (KDCA 2026-27 season): children 6 months to 14 (expanded from 13 this season), pregnant women, 65+; free at about 23,000 designated clinics or public health centers regardless of registered address; Sept 21 2026 to Apr 30 2027; seniors start by age band in October, 75+ first; trivalent vaccine; 65+ COVID shot same schedule, same-visit recommended; records checked on the Vaccination Helper (예방접종도우미) site
title: In Korea, the Flu Shot Is Free for Kids and Seniors

slides.headline: In Korea, the flu shot is **free for kids and seniors.**
slides.note: Walk into almost any neighborhood clinic.

slides.headline: Who gets it **free**
slides.body: Every child from 6 months to 14 years old, every pregnant woman and everyone 65 or older. The government pays the full cost.

slides.headline: Up to **age 14 now**
slides.body: This season the age limit for children went up from 13 to 14, so middle schoolers are covered too.

slides.headline: Your local **clinic**
slides.body: The shot is given at neighborhood clinics and public health centers. It doesn't matter where your address is registered. Pick the one closest to you.

slides.headline: Oldest **go first**
slides.body: Seniors start in October in age groups, beginning with those 75 and older. Kids who need two doses start first, in September.

slides.headline: Two shots, **one visit**
slides.body: People 65 and older can get a free COVID shot on the same schedule. Health officials recommend getting both at the same visit.

slides.headline: Records **online**
slides.body: Every shot goes into a national record. Parents can look up their children's vaccinations on the government's Vaccination Helper website.

slides.headline: Clinics **giving free shots**
slides.body: Designated clinics nationwide, plus public health centers. The free season runs from September 21 to April 30.

slides.headline: Everyone else **pays**
slides.body: Adults between 15 and 64 pay at the clinic, usually a few tens of thousands of won. Many companies cover it as a perk.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.

caption:
Every fall, Korean kids, pregnant women and anyone 65 or older can walk into a neighborhood clinic and get a flu shot for free.

This season, the free age for children went up to 14.

Is the flu shot free where you live?
reply: Small tip: if you're 65 or older in Korea, bring your ID card. The clinic checks it before the free shot.
fact_check: 1·2장: 무료 대상 생후 6개월~14세, 임신부, 65세 이상(질병관리청 2026-08-25 보도, 정책브리핑).
5장: 2회 대상 어린이 9/21 시작, 어르신 75세 이상부터 연령대별 순차(같은 보도). 75세 시작일 10/6·10/12 출처 엇갈려 날짜는 뺌.
6장: 65세 이상 코로나19 같은 일정, 동시 접종 권고(같은 보도).
9장: 15~64세 유료, 가격 '수만 원'은 일반 시세(병원별 상이), 회사 지원은 일부 복지 관행이라 'many'.
reply: 어르신 신분증 지참 안내(보건소·지자체 안내 일반).
